info.title: MaqamTravels API Platform
info.description:
## Enterprise API Reference
Welcome to the MaqamTravels API documentation. 
This reference lists all routes, models, authentication policies, and response envelopes.

### Authentication
Secure endpoints require authorization through Bearer JWT. 
Select the **Authorize** lock button below and supply your token.

post.summary: Recheck room availability and lock rate (BlockRoom)
post.description: Mandatory price and cancellation policy revalidation step before creating a booking or initiating payment. Calls SRDV `/BlockRoom` API to confirm live rate availability and receive authoritative pricing. Returns a **single-use** `recheckId` token valid for **3 minutes (180 seconds)**. If `priceChanged` or `policyChanged` is `true`, the caller must re-confirm by sending `acceptChanges: true` in the subsequent `POST /hotels/bookings` request.

200.description: Room selection rechecked and rate locked successfully.

post.description:
Atomically consumes the single-use `recheckId` token and initializes a local `HotelBooking` record in `AWAITING_PAYMENT` status. The booking record is persisted in a MongoDB transaction along with an audit event and an outbox event.

**Payment Window**: After creation, the booking expires in 15 minutes (`expiresInSeconds` in the response). Payment must be initiated within this window.

**Idempotency**: Sending an `Idempotency-Key` header is strongly recommended to prevent duplicate booking creation on network retries. Duplicate requests with the same key return the existing booking.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key (UUID recommended) to prevent duplicate booking requests on retries. Strongly recommended.

get.summary: Get All Available Admin-Created Visas & Self-Applied Visas

Unified endpoint for users. In a single request without query parameters, it returns:
1. All available active Visa catalogue offerings created by Admin (with pricing, countryPicture, countryFlag, requirements).
2. All Visa applications/batches submitted by the logged-in user themself (with application status, applicants, payment info).
3. Overview summary metrics.

post.summary: Apply for Visa (Single Applicant or Multiple Applicants with Documents)
post.description:
Apply for a single visa or multiple visas in a single endpoint with document uploads.
- **Single Visa**: Pass user details as an Object (`userDetails`, `applicant`, or flat in form).
- **Multiple Visas**: Pass user details as an Array of Objects (`userDetails` or `applicants`).
- Supports both `application/json` (with pre-existing document URLs) and `multipart/form-data` (with binary file uploads).
- Documents supported: `passportScan`, `photo`, `additionalDocs`.

HotelSearchRequest.description:
**Hotel Discovery Search Payload**

Requires `cityName` (or `cityId`) + `checkIn` + `checkOut`. All other fields have smart defaults: - `countryCode`: Auto-derived from city map when `cityName` is provided. - `guestNationality`: Defaults to `IN`. - `currency`: Defaults to `INR`. - `rooms`: Auto-constructed from `adults` / `children` / `childAges` / `numRooms` shorthand if omitted.

Use `GET /api/v1/hotels/cities?q=<name>` to autocomplete city names and retrieve SRDV `cityId`s.

cityName.description: Human-readable city name. Use GET /api/v1/hotels/cities to search. Resolved against 136k-city DB.

cityId.description: SRDV numeric city identifier (alternative to cityName). Takes precedence over cityName.

checkIn.description: Check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be today or later.

checkOut.description: Check-out date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be strictly after checkIn.

adults.description: Total number of adult guests across all rooms (default 1). Used when `rooms[]` is omitted.

children.description: Number of children (optional, default 0). Used when `rooms[]` is omitted.

childAges.description: Array of child ages corresponding to `children` count. Used when `rooms[]` is omitted.

numRooms.description: Number of rooms to request (default 1). Used when `rooms[]` is omitted.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Auto-derived from city map when `cityName` is provided.

guestNationality.description: Guest nationality ISO country code (default IN).

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (default INR). Convenience fee is only applied in INR.

rooms.description: Full room allocation array — use this for multi-room bookings with different occupancy per room. Overrides top-level `adults`/`children`/`numRooms` shorthand.

searchId.description: Opaque search session UUID. Must be passed in subsequent `GET /hotels/{hotelId}?searchId=` and `POST /hotels/recheck` calls. Session expires after 5 minutes (300 seconds).

expiresInSeconds.description: Search session cache TTL — **5 minutes (300 seconds)**. Sessions cached and deduplicated by query key.

nights.description: Calculated duration of stay in nights (checkOut − checkIn).

hotels.description: List of available hotel properties matching the search criteria.

HotelCard.description: Single hotel search result card with pricing and metadata.

id.description: Provider hotel code. Use this as `hotelId` in subsequent GET /hotels/{hotelId} and POST /hotels/recheck calls.

resultIndex.description: SRDV result index used internally for subsequent API calls.

srdvIndex.description: SRDV provider shard index used in BlockRoom / HotelRoom calls.

name.example: Hotel Airport Crown- Near Saki Naka

category.description: Hotel category label from supplier (e.g. '3 Star', 'Apartment').

description.example: Conveniently located budget hotel with modern amenities near Mumbai Airport.
description.description: Hotel description text. May be empty for some properties in search results (enriched in hotel details).

address.example: 90 Feet Rd, Saki Naka, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400072

latitude.description: GPS latitude (null when not provided by supplier).

longitude.description: GPS longitude (null when not provided by supplier).

mapLink.description: Google Maps link to the hotel property.

imageUrls.description: Hotel image URLs. May be empty for some properties.

fromPrice.description: Pricing summary for this hotel. Standard users see major-unit display fields only; admin/developer tokens receive full minor-unit financial breakdown.

perNightPrice.description: **Public**: Customer selling price per night in major currency units. Display as '₹4,523/night'.

totalPrice.description: **Public**: Customer total for entire stay in major currency units. Display as '₹9,045 total'.

amountMinor.description: **Admin**: Customer total in minor units (paise for INR). Use for payment gateway charges.

supplierAmountMinor.description: **Admin**: Raw supplier cost for stay in minor units.

markupMinor.description: **Admin**: Applied markup amount in minor units.

feeMinor.description: **Admin**: Flat convenience fee in minor units.

customerTotalMinor.description: **Admin**: Final customer-payable amount in minor units.

pricingVersion.description: **Admin**: Pricing engine version string (encodes markup % and fee applied).

HotelDetailsResponse.description: Hotel property detail page data including description, images, and available room rate plans.

name.example: Hotel Airport Crown- Near Saki Naka

address.example: 90 Feet Rd, Saki Naka, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400072

description.example: Conveniently located budget hotel with modern amenities near Mumbai Airport.

rooms.description: Available room rate plans. Pass the `id` of your chosen room to POST /hotels/recheck as `selectedRooms[].roomId`.

HotelRoom.description: A selectable room rate plan for a hotel property.

id.description: Opaque room rate identifier. Pass this as `selectedRooms[].roomId` in POST /hotels/recheck.

board.description: Meal plan / board type (e.g. 'Room Only', 'Breakfast Included').

capacity.description: Maximum adult occupancy for this room.

price.description: Customer selling price **per night** in major currency units (includes markup + fee).

totalPrice.description: Customer total selling price for the **full stay** in major currency units.

nights.description: Number of stay nights used for `totalPrice` calculation.

refundable.description: Whether this room rate is refundable per supplier cancellation policy.

cancellationPolicy.description: Cancellation policy for this room. Can be either: - A **structured array** of cancellation windows `CancellationPolicyEntry[]` (when supplier provides machine-readable data), or - A **plain string** fallback (e.g. `"Standard cancellation policy applies."`) when structured data is unavailable.

srdvRoomDetails.description: **Admin/Developer only**: Raw SRDV supplier room node used for BlockRoom and Book operations.

priceSnapshot.description: **Admin/Developer only**: Full minor-unit financial breakdown for this room.

supplierAmountMinor.description: Supplier per-night cost in minor units.

markupMinor.description: Applied markup per night in minor units.

feeMinor.description: Flat convenience fee per night in minor units.

customerTotalMinor.description: Customer per-night total in minor units.

CancellationPolicyEntry.description: A single cancellation charge window returned from the supplier.

fromDate.description: Start of the cancellation charge window (ISO 8601). Null means immediately.

toDate.description: End of the cancellation charge window. Null means open-ended.

charge.description: Cancellation charge amount in major currency units for this window.

chargeType.description: Charge type code (1 = Fixed amount, 2 = Percentage of room rate).

HotelRecheckRequest.description: Payload to revalidate room availability and lock a rate with the supplier (SRDV BlockRoom). Must be completed before initiating payment.

searchId.description: Active search session ID returned by POST /hotels/search.

hotelId.description: Selected hotel code (the `id` field from HotelCard).

selectedRooms.description: Array of selected room rate plan IDs with quantities.

roomId.description: Room rate ID from `HotelRoom.id` in GET /hotels/{hotelId} response.

quantity.description: Number of this room type to book (default 1).

HotelRecheckResponse.description: Result of the BlockRoom price/policy revalidation. If `priceChanged` or `policyChanged` is `true`, the client MUST re-confirm with `acceptChanges: true` in POST /hotels/bookings.

recheckId.description: Single-use recheck snapshot token. Pass this to POST /hotels/bookings as `recheckId`. **Expires in 3 minutes (180 seconds)** and is consumed atomically on first use.

expiresInSeconds.description: Recheck quote cache TTL — **3 minutes (180 seconds)**.

priceChanged.description: True if the supplier returned a different price during BlockRoom vs. the original search result.

policyChanged.description: True if the supplier's cancellation terms changed during BlockRoom.

hotel.description: Hotel property summary enriched with latest supplier data during BlockRoom.

fromPrice.description: May be null if supplier did not return pricing in the BlockRoom enrichment response.

roomSnapshots.description: Confirmed room snapshots returned by the supplier. Selling prices are recalculated from BlockRoom response.

price.description: Aggregated price summary for the confirmed booking (customer-facing display values).

perNightPrice.description: Customer selling price per night in major currency units.

totalPrice.description: Customer total for full stay in major currency units.

cancellationPolicy.description: Array of cancellation policies per selected room snapshot.

HotelBookingCreateRequest.description: Payload to create a hotel booking record in `AWAITING_PAYMENT` status. The `recheckId` is **consumed atomically** (single-use token) and cannot be reused. An `Idempotency-Key` header should be sent to prevent duplicate booking records.

recheckId.description: Single-use token generated by POST /hotels/recheck. Expires after 3 minutes.

acceptChanges.description: Required to be `true` when `priceChanged` or `policyChanged` was `true` in the recheck response. Otherwise the request returns HTTP 409.

guests.description: List of all hotel guests. The first entry is treated as the lead passenger.

HotelGuest.description: Guest / passenger detail for hotel booking.

email.description: Guest email. Used for booking confirmation notifications.

age.description: Guest age. Defaults to 30 for adults and 10 for children if omitted.

pan.description: Indian PAN number. Mandatory when supplier flags room as `IsPANMandatory`.

passportNo.description: Passport number. Mandatory for international stays when supplier flags `IsPassportMandatory`.

HotelBookingResponse.description: Hotel booking record in its current lifecycle state.

id.description: MongoDB document ID of the hotel booking.

status.description: Normalized public booking lifecycle status: - `PAYMENT_PENDING` — Booking created, awaiting payment (15-min countdown applies) - `PAYMENT_RECEIVED` — Payment verified, supplier booking in progress - `CONFIRMING` — Async worker is calling supplier API - `CONFIRMED` — Supplier confirmed the reservation - `FAILED` — Supplier rejected the booking (refund initiated automatically) - `CANCELLED` — Booking cancelled by user - `CANCELLATION_PENDING` — Cancellation request sent to supplier - `REFUND_PENDING` — Refund is queued for gateway processing - `REFUNDED` — Refund processed successfully - `COMPLETED` — Stay completed

providerBookingId.description: Supplier reservation reference ID (available after CONFIRMED status).

amountMinor.description: Total customer-payable amount in minor units (paise for INR). Use for payment gateway order creation.

expiresInSeconds.description: Payment countdown timer in seconds. Only non-zero when status is `PAYMENT_PENDING`. Frontend should redirect to payment within this window.

HotelBookingSummary.description: Condensed hotel booking item for listing views.

hotelName.example: Hotel Airport Crown- Near Saki Naka

totalAmountMinor.description: Total amount paid in minor units.

HotelCancelResponse.description: Result of a hotel booking cancellation request.

cancellationReference.description: Supplier cancellation reference number. `LOCAL_CANCEL` when cancelled before supplier confirmation.

penalty.description: Supplier cancellation charge in major currency units. 0 means fully refunded. Refund is processed asynchronously.

HotelCitySuggestion.description: City autocomplete match item returned from the destination search.

cityId.description: SRDV numeric city identifier. Use as `cityId` in POST /hotels/search.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for this city.

isOptional.description: Whether customer can opt-out in customizer

allowSwap.description: Whether customer can swap with matching destination offer

notes.example: Depart Delhi Airport Terminal 3 at 08:30 AM

title.example: Arrival in Dubai & Dhow Dinner Cruise

description.example: Land at DXB International Airport, private transfer to hotel, evening Marina Dhow Cruise.
All-inclusive Dubai holiday package including return flights, 4-star hotel stay, and desert safari.

offerRefs.description: Array of bundled Offer components (minimum 2 offers required)

bundleDiscountPercentage.description: Percentage discount applied to unbundled sum to form sellPrice

availableSlots.description: Dynamic availability calculated from lowest stock among bundled offers

packageSnapshot.description: Frozen snapshot of package configuration and selections at checkout

assignedTo.description: CRM Operations Agent / Case Officer ID

description.example: Complete Dubai package with flights and 4-star luxury stay

includeGuide.description: Whether the package includes a tour guide addon option

guideActive.description: Alternative flag for guide availability (synonym for includeGuide)

guideLocation.description: Location where the tour guide assists (e.g. Makkah, Madinah)

guidePrice.description: Baseline retail price of the guide addon

offerRefs.description: Array of bundled offers (must contain at least 2 components)

sellPrice.description: Optional manual override. If omitted, calculated automatically via Option A pricing.

assignedTo.description: User ID of the Operations staff / Case Officer

meta.description: Metadata containing pagination, tokens, or headers details.

docType.description: Machine identifier for document (e.g., passportScan, photo, bankStatement)

label.description: User friendly title shown in the UI

description.example: Color scan of valid passport with at least 6 months validity

basePrice.description: Wholesale cost paid to Embassy or Visa processing partner

submittedBy.description: User ID who created the application

assignedAgent.description: User ID of the assigned CRM Case Officer

adminNotes.example: Visa approved and e-visa PDF issued by GDRFA

adminRemarks.example: Assigned to Dubai visa processing desk

adminNotes.example: Visa issued successfully by GDRFA Dubai
